role: World.getEntitiesWithinAABBExcludingEntity over the item-entity world: visits the loaded chunks two blocks past the box and their sections two blocks past it (clamped), and collects every entity whose box intersects, in chunk-x, chunk-z, section, list order.
gpu: line 16-24, function chunk_at: linear search of the chunk table for each chunk coordinate
line 50, function entityquery_in_box: a section list holds ie pool slots (sec_items); results follow each section list's order (container-order dependence carried as data) (lane/gpuarena, L3)
notes: Returns the total count even when it exceeds cap (only the first cap are written). The optional IEntitySelector argument of Chunk.getEntitiesWithinAABBForEntity is not ported (no selector). Callers: explosion.c and projectile.c. The listed tests exercise it through those callers (not checked that each hits it).
